title: Nexus RunDetail
description: Full detail for GET /v1/daemon/compute/runs/{run_id}. Extends RunSummary with invocation params, full proposals (on succeeded), error (on failed), and accept metadata (on applied).

module_version.description: Version of the module at invocation time.

branch_id.description: Timeline branch the run was scoped to (defaults to root when omitted in request).

invocation_params.description: Module-specific invocation parameters as provided in the run request.

proposals.description: Full module output proposals. Present only when status is "succeeded".

error.description: Honest error detail when status is "failed".

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of run creation.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of last status change.

accepted_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when accepted. Present only when status is "applied".

timeline_event_ids.description: IDs of the Timeline events created during accept. Present only when status is "applied".
